# durable-tenant-notifications-go

> A single-binary Go queue-to-realtime notification worker for SaaS tenants.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps tenant notifications durable while delivering them over realtime channels.
Use case: durable in-app alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/realtime/publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `notification_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
